cues.en: Over the holidays, I wanted to find out the truth about where the tone comes from in an electric guitar.
cues.zh: 假期里，我想弄清楚电吉他的音色到底来自哪里。

cues.en: What makes one electric guitar sound different from another when they're plugged into the same amp?
cues.zh: 当两把电吉他插进同一个音箱时，是什么让它们的声音不一样？

cues.en: I've read and heard all sorts of ways that every single part on the guitar can make a difference in the sound but I don't actually know if any of that's true. I wanted to take the time to actually test them and capture the results with audio and video so you guys can see for yourself and decide what you think is important too. First thing I did was email three very high end guitar builders whose guitars I've personally played and enjoyed very much. And I asked them the question,
cues.zh: 我读到、听到过各种说法，说吉他上每一个部件都会影响声音，但我并不确定这些说法是否属实。我想花时间实际测试一下，用音频和视频记录结果，让你们自己看，也判断一下你们认为什么重要。我做的第一件事，是给三位顶级吉他制造者发邮件，我亲自弹过并非常喜欢他们的吉他。我问了他们一个问题：

cues.en: what five factors in an electric guitar make the most difference in the amplified sound? Sound. Here's how they responded.
cues.zh: 电吉他中哪五个因素对放大后的声音影响最大？音色。以下是他们的回答。

cues.en: I was surprised at how different their lists were from each other. And with these factors in mind, I needed a test guitar that I could hack up and change parts on without feeling stress.
cues.zh: 我很惊讶他们的清单彼此差异那么大。考虑到这些因素，我需要一把能随便改装、换零件而不心疼的测试吉他。

cues.en: So I bought a kit for a $100 and put it together.
cues.zh: 所以我花100美元买了个套件，自己组装了起来。

cues.en: As a baseline, I tested it against my Tom Anderson Tele because almost everything about the Anderson is different than the parts caster.
cues.zh: 作为基准，我把它和我那把 Tom Anderson Tele 做了对比测试，因为 Anderson 的几乎一切都和这把拼装吉他不同。

cues.en: The only difference here and with any test in this video is the guitars.
cues.zh: 这里以及本视频中任何测试的唯一区别，就是所用的吉他。

cues.en: Everything after the guitar is identical and everything before the guitar, so the player, the picks, the strings, the spot on the strings where the pick hits, how hard the pick hits, how fast the pick hits, all of that is controlled as tightly as I can. So the only difference that you're hearing is the difference between the guitars. This
cues.zh: 吉他之后的一切都相同，吉他之前的一切也都相同，所以演奏者、拨片、琴弦、拨片击弦的位置、击弦的力度、击弦的速度，所有这些我都尽可能严格地控制。所以你听到的唯一差别，就是吉他之间的差别。这

cues.en: list is long but it's finite. So I started chipping away at it.
cues.zh: 份清单很长，但它是有限的。于是我开始一点点啃它。

cues.en: The first thing I did was replace the pickup in the parts caster with a Seymour Duncan vintage stack and tested that.
cues.zh: 我做的第一件事，是把 Parts Caster 上的拾音器换成 Seymour Duncan Vintage Stack，然后做了测试。

cues.en: And after testing that, I compared it to the Anderson which also has a vintage stack.
cues.zh: 测试完之后，我把它和 Anderson 做了对比，那把琴也装了 Vintage Stack。

cues.en: Then I tried a pickup height test. The pickup was set at kind of a medium level so then I cranked it down really low and then up really high to see if that made a difference.
cues.zh: 然后我做了拾音器高度测试。拾音器原本设在中等高度，我把它调得很低，再调得很高，看看有没有差别。

cues.en: After that, I continued forward through a bunch of tests including standing the headstock down to a normal shape.
cues.zh: 之后，我继续做了一系列测试，包括把琴头打磨成正常形状。

cues.en: Having a loose versus tightened neck joint.
cues.zh: 对比琴颈接合处松动和拧紧的情况。

cues.en: I tried brass saddles versus steel.
cues.zh: 我试过黄铜琴码和钢制琴码的对比。

cues.en: Using a traditional thin steel ashtray bridge instead of the longer thicker steel bridge that came with the kit.
cues.zh: 用传统的薄钢烟灰缸式琴桥，替换套件自带的更长更厚的钢制琴桥。

cues.en: I tried top loading the strings versus putting the strings through the body.
cues.zh: 我试过顶部上弦和穿体上弦两种方式。

cues.en: And I tried using a strap bridge with no plate.
cues.zh: 我还试了不带底板的 strap bridge。

cues.en: When I did the no plate test, the crude pickup mount I fashioned wasn't very stable and I couldn't keep the pickup in one spot.
cues.zh: 做无底板测试时，我临时做的简陋拾音器固定座不太稳，拾音器老是移位。

cues.en: The differences I noticed even during the same take based on tiny amounts the pickup was moving frustrated me because I couldn't accurately test the strap bridge and I hadn't really been paying close attention to how close the pickup was to the strings.
cues.zh: 即使在同一次录音里，我注意到的差异也只是拾音器位置那点微小变化造成的，这让我很沮丧，因为我没法准确测试 Strat 琴桥，而且我之前也没真正留意拾音器离琴弦有多近。

cues.en: So I started to wonder whether the test I had done were even valid and if any difference heard between the bridges or the neck joint or the headstock shape was just from the pickup being slightly different distances from the strings before and after the modifications I had done. This came to a head when I was testing necks and I'd put the parts caster neck on my blue strat copy to see how much difference an unfinished maple fretboard neck had from a finished rosewood fretboard neck. The heel angle didn't exactly match, so the action was ridiculously high. And I made the prediction before testing that with the string so far away, the tone would sound weaker no matter what the differences in the necks were.
cues.zh: 于是我开始怀疑，我之前做的测试到底还有没有效，以及在不同琴桥、琴颈连接处或琴头形状之间听到的任何差异，是不是仅仅因为在我改装前后，拾音器离琴弦的距离略有不同。这个问题在我测试琴颈时变得很突出：我把一个 Partscaster 琴颈装到我的蓝色仿 Strat 上，想看看未上漆的枫木指板琴颈和上过漆的玫瑰木指板琴颈有多大差别。琴颈跟部角度并不完全匹配，所以弦距高得离谱。而我在测试前就预测，琴弦离得那么远，不管琴颈有什么差异，音色都会听起来更弱。

cues.en: So I asked myself,
cues.zh: 于是我问自己，

cues.en: what if I militantly
cues.zh: 如果我较真地

cues.en: matched the distance from the pickup to the strings? I got my feeler gauges and measured the distance from the low e string to the pickup and the high e string to the pickup on my Anderson and matched it as close as I could on the parts caster. Then I tested it.
cues.zh: 去匹配拾音器到琴弦的距离，会怎样？我拿出塞尺，量了我那把 Anderson 上低音 E 弦到拾音器、以及高音 E 弦到拾音器的距离，然后在我那把 Partscaster 上尽可能照着匹配。然后我做了测试。

cues.en: This was a turning point for me. There were a lot of things different about these two guitars and not a lot that was the same. At this point in testing, here's a list of all the things that these two guitars had in common.
cues.zh: 这对我来说是个转折点。这两把吉他有很多不同之处，相同的地方并不多。测试进行到这一步，下面是这两把吉他所有共同点的清单。

cues.en: I became more interested in testing the things that were on this list and a big one was the guitar body. What if I took a radically different approach? Could it sound the same as my Anderson?
cues.zh: 我越来越想测试清单上的东西，其中一个重点就是吉他琴身。如果我采用完全不同的做法会怎样？声音能和我的 Anderson 一样吗？

cues.en: I'm out in the barn and it's time to pick a new guitar.
cues.zh: 我在谷仓里，该挑一把新吉他了。

cues.en: So...
cues.zh: 那么……

cues.en: This one looks good to me.
cues.zh: 我觉得这把不错。

cues.en: Got it.
cues.zh: 拿到了。

cues.en: This is the two by four guitar. It was made from a piece of scrap wood bolted to a neck from a '72 reissue thin line telly. The neck has a thick finish on it and a three bolt neck joint. The neck radius is 7.25
cues.zh: 这就是那把 2x4 吉他。它由一块废木料做成，用螺栓固定在一根 '72 复刻 Thinline Tele 的琴颈上。琴颈上有很厚的漆面，采用三螺栓琴颈连接。琴颈半径是 7.25

cues.en: inches. Steel saddles were installed in place of the brass ones on the bridge. The strings are top loaded. The pickup was wired directly to the output jack with no electronics in between.
cues.zh: 英寸。琴桥上原本的黄铜弦鞍换成了钢制弦鞍。琴弦采用顶部穿弦。拾音器直接接到输出插孔，中间没有任何电路。

cues.en: But it had a Seymour Duncan vintage stack pickup just like the Anderson and the height had been precisely adjusted.
cues.zh: 它装的是和 Anderson 一样的 Seymour Duncan vintage stack 拾音器，高度也经过精确调整。

cues.en: So I tested it.
cues.zh: 于是我测试了一下。

cues.en: I couldn't get it to exactly match.
cues.zh: 我没法让它完全匹配。

cues.en: I thought maybe the body wood does play a role or maybe it's something to do with the neck finish
cues.zh: 我猜也许琴体木料确实有影响，或者和琴颈漆面有关

cues.en: but I was hearing a harsh top end. So my thought was that maybe it's because I wired straight from the pick up to the output jack and didn't include any electronics to bleed highs off the ground. So I installed electronics.
cues.zh: 但我听到的高频很刺耳。所以我想，也许是因为我直接从拾音器接到输出插孔，没有加任何电子元件把高频旁路到地。于是我把电子元件装上了。

cues.en: This was the bingo moment for me. I had the data. I captured captured it on video. You just saw it. At this point, here's what the two guitars did have in common.
cues.zh: 这就是我的顿悟时刻。我拿到了数据。我把它拍成了视频。你们刚刚也看到了。到这时，两把吉他真正共同的地方是这些。

cues.en: That's a pretty small list. I was satisfied with my research and ready to stop but I had this voice in my head of all the players and builders out there who have thought about electric guitar a certain way for much longer than I have. And that seeing a two by four plank guitar still might not be a grand enough gesture to push past deeply rooted beliefs. So I went even farther for one last test.
cues.zh: 那是一份相当短的清单。我对自己的研究很满意，准备就此停下，但我脑海里一直有个声音，来自那些比我更早、更久地以某种方式思考电吉他的演奏者和制琴师。而且，看到一把用二乘四木条做的吉他，可能仍不足以打破根深蒂固的看法。于是我又走远了一步，做了最后一次测试。

cues.en: This is the air guitar. I made it out of a bench and a shelf.
cues.zh: 这就是那把空气吉他。我用一张工作台和一个架子做成了它。

cues.en: My dad made the bench in 1990 for repairing motorcycles.
cues.zh: 这张工作台是我爸在 1990 年为了修摩托车做的。

cues.en: The shelf is upside down sitting on two chairs and weighted down with a pair of Honda engines.
cues.zh: 架子倒放在两把椅子上，上面压着两台本田发动机。

cues.en: The ends of the shelf are braced against the bench with two by fours so the strings don't pull the shelf closer to the bench when tuned up.
cues.zh: 架子两端用二乘四木条顶住工作台，这样调好音后，琴弦就不会把架子拉得离工作台更近。

cues.en: The headstock is a piece of wood with tuners put in it.
cues.zh: 琴头是一块木头，上面装了弦钮。

cues.en: The nut is the bottom half of a metal locking nut meant to go the Floyd Rose type bridge.
cues.zh: 琴枕是金属锁弦枕的下半部分，本来要装在 Floyd Rose 类型的琴桥上。

cues.en: 25 and a half inches away are the steel saddles on the steel top loaded bridge with a Seymour Duncan vintage stack mounted in the plate and all of that screwed into the bench.
cues.zh: 25.5 英寸之外，是钢制顶装式琴桥上的钢制弦鞍，拾音器板上装着 Seymour Duncan Vintage Stack，而这一切都用螺丝固定在台面上。

cues.en: The pickup is wired to a disembodied tele control plate with a 250 k volume pot.
cues.zh: 拾音器接到一块单独拆下来的 Tele 控制板上，上面带一个 250k 的音量电位器。

cues.en: This is wired to a jack and a guitar cable goes from the jack straight to my combo amp.
cues.zh: 这又接到一个插孔上，吉他线从插孔直接连到我的 combo 音箱。

cues.en: The air guitar was tuned to open d and so was my Anderson tele. I matched their pickup heights and strummed an open chord on both multiple times on the same spot on the strings.
cues.zh: 那把 Air Guitar 调成了开放 D 调弦，我的 Anderson Tele 也是。我把两者的拾音器高度调到一致，并在两把琴弦的同一位置多次扫开放和弦。

cues.en: Here are the things that the Anderson and the Air Guitar had in common.
cues.zh: 以下是 Anderson 和 Air Guitar 的共同点。

cues.en: Tuning.
cues.zh: 调弦。

cues.en: Strings.
cues.zh: 琴弦。

cues.en: Scale length.
cues.zh: 有效弦长。

cues.en: Pickup.
cues.zh: 拾音器。

cues.en: Pickup distance to strings.
cues.zh: 拾音器到琴弦的距离。

cues.en: Pickup position along the strings,
cues.zh: 拾音器沿琴弦的位置，

cues.en: pickup slant angle,
cues.zh: 拾音器倾斜角度，

cues.en: and effective volume pop value.
cues.zh: 以及有效音量电位器阻值。

cues.en: In the future, I'll be looking deeper into these factors.
cues.zh: 之后我会更深入地研究这些因素。

cues.en: Hopefully, you'll join me.
cues.zh: 希望你能加入我。

cues.en: That's awesome.
cues.zh: 太棒了。
